primary_gt.interpretation: The 20.40 reported wind-dry-burn index crosses the high threshold because all three report anchors are present, early fire activity spans 4 of 10 event days, and the report gives about 17.0 kha burned.

required_claims: Uses March 4-13, 2022 as a 10-day inclusive event window.
Uses March 4-7 as the 4-day early active fire interval within the event window.
Counts strong winds, dry weather, and westerly smoke transport as three report anchors.
Uses nearly 17,000 hectares as 17.0 thousand hectares.
Computes 3 * (4 / 10) * 17.0 = 20.40 and classifies it as high.
forbidden_claims: Using off-event Open-Meteo or NASA POWER daily weather values as local Uljin-Samcheok measurements.
Treating the index as measured PM2.5 concentration, smoke dose, health outcome, ignition cause, or exact spread path.
acceptable_variants: Final answer may be reported as 20.4 or 20.40 if the class and units are clear.
Units may be described as a thousand-hectare report-anchor index or equivalent dimensionless screening units.

criteria.name: Final numeric index
criteria.description: Reports the reported wind-dry-burn forcing index as 20.40 or an equivalent value within +/-0.05.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 2-3 points for a value within +/-1.0 caused by rounding or a small arithmetic error.

criteria.name: Report anchor extraction
criteria.description: Finds all three report anchors: strong winds, dry weather, and westerly smoke transport toward southern Japan.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1 point for each correct anchor and 1 point for correctly counting the anchors.

criteria.name: Early activity window
criteria.description: Uses March 4-13 as a 10-day event window and March 4-7 as a 4-day early active fire interval.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1-2 points if the dates are identified but one inclusive-day calculation is wrong.

criteria.name: Burned-area extraction
criteria.description: Extracts nearly 17,000 hectares and converts it to 17.0 thousand hectares for the formula.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1-2 points if the hectare value is found but conversion or rounding is wrong.

criteria.name: Formula and threshold
criteria.description: Applies RWDBFI = A * (E / N) * Hkha and classifies the result as high because it is at least 20.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1-2 points for using the right variables but misapplying the threshold or fraction.

criteria.name: Bounded interpretation
criteria.description: Interprets the score as a report-grounded screening index, not a measured PM2.5 concentration, smoke dose, or health outcome.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1 point for a mostly bounded interpretation with one minor overstatement.

criteria.name: Requested output format
criteria.description: Returns compact JSON with the requested top-level fields.
criteria.partial_credit: Give no credit if the answer is unstructured prose only.

notes: Off-event Open-Meteo and NASA POWER weather files are not used in this ground truth.
The score is computed from declared event anchor metadata and NASA Earth Observatory report text.
